tools.name: discover_support
tools.description: What customer service can and cannot do, the ticket rules, and whether this connection is anonymous or tied to an account.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Retrieve approved help articles about how Babelii works (ordering, payment by link, tracking, limits, policies). Answer only from the returned references; if none fit, say so and offer a ticket. Never use them as a current price, balance or order status.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Consult Babelii's product adviser: it interprets the customer's need (for example "paket data XL murah untuk 3 hari") and returns current catalogue recommendations with price, volume, validity, availability and a buy_url. tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Use exactly one selector. A bare order_number gives coarse status only. A full track_url copied from the customer's checkout page unlocks the details; never invent or guess one. order_id works only for a connected account that owns the order. Never ask for passwords, PIN or OTP.

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Open a support ticket for staff, only after search_help did not solve the problem or the customer asks for a person. name is required; contact (phone or email) is optional. Returns a reference and, for anonymous callers, a one-time access_code: give both to the customer exactly as returned. Limited

tools.name: ticket_status
tools.description: Status and staff replies of a ticket. Anonymous callers need the reference and the access_code from contact_support; a connected account needs only the reference of its own ticket.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "order_status" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "support" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_help, contact_support · Private data: order_status, contact_support · Public sink: contact_support.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_help, contact_support · Private data: order_status, contact_support · Public sink: contact_support

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
